desc.cn: 快、準。票價對標二等座常見成交價；另含進出站地鐵約 0.5–1h。
desc.en: Fast & punctual. Fares track typical 2nd-class HSR; +0.5–1h metro to stations.

desc.cn: 遠程常見選擇。票價偏經濟艙中位；機場往返與安檢吃掉時間。
desc.en: Common for long hops. Mid-range economy fare; airports eat door-to-door time.

desc.cn: 省錢但慢。對標省際大巴常見價，腰與 sanity 一起繳稅。
desc.en: Cheap & slow. Tracks typical coach fares; spine and sanity both pay.

desc.cn: 用一晚睡眠換票價。對標硬臥/動臥常見區間。
desc.en: Trade a night’s sleep for fare. Tracks hard-sleeper / D-sleeper ranges.

notes.sources: 12306/Ctrip ranges 2025–2026: BJ–SH 2nd-class ~¥550–670 (~5–6h); BJ–XA ~¥515–593 (~4.5–6h); flights BJ–SZ/CD often ¥500–1200 economy. sameRegionFactor discounts e.g. SH–HZ / CD–CQ short hops. Sanity/battery are game friction, not published fares.
notes.attractionTickets: Palace Museum adult ¥60; Badaling Wall peak ¥40 (+shuttle/cable often pushes day to ¥150–250); Universal Beijing day ticket commonly ¥500+; panda base ~¥55–58. Event JSON tickets aligned to these bands.
